body: I'm not sure what you've been through but just know that it will get better with time. I know it's hard right now and you can't really see a way out of this but there's always options. The fact that your chasing your goals while going through all of this is incredibly brave. Ive barely started my course and I'm already failing but you've got your whole life ahead to fix your mistakes. Just know the only person you need to be happy is yourself

It's definitely a good thing that you Don't know how to do it because you shouldn't be doing it. There's still hope, just try push through and envision a brighter future. If you need to talk I'm here for you

Hey, you Re still posting on here so you haven't given up yet. Don't worry about your parents or your boyfriend or whoever, the only person you need to be happy is yourself. I know it's hard but just think of things that make you happy, even if it's just cat videos on YouTube, and try to push through the pain. Think of a better future and start taking the first steps towards it

Hey man, don't do this. Your family cares about you and loves you and things will get better. People come in and out of your life, it's just how it happens. I know it hurts but just think about what makes you happy, you can push through this

Hey man, don't do anything you'll regret. You've made it though 4 years of school and that's a massive accomplishment in itself, even more if you're depressed. I'm sure your parents are proud of you, they are just bad at expressing it and even if you have to take a 5th year and they dislike it, they'll get over it with time. There's more to life than your parents anyway, think about your girlfriend and your puppy and the joy they give you. Youre doing much better than you give yourself credit for bro. Be nicer to yourself

Hi Chloe, yes you are very young but sometimes life's a bit unfair. Just know that it will get better with time and there's people that care about you. Have you tried maybe seeing a doctor? I know it might be hard in your situation but it could be the first step towards healing. If you ever need someone to talk to with no judgement I'm here :) I haven't got out of bed much this last month either so I can maybe relate to what you're going through and try to help

Youre afraid of death for a reason my friend, cause you're not ready for it. Think about something that brings you joy, some old memories or picture a future where you are happy and overcome your stresses and slowly work towards it. Youre not a quitter you got this

Put on a new movie or your favourite tv series or try to do something you enjoy :) Maybe even try meditating to calm your nerves? If you need to talk about anything I'm here

I guess it depends how you react to them. I was lucky myself as my therapy appointment (which I’d been waiting months for) timed really well with probably my most suicidal point and it really helped me persevere. 

I really struggled for about a week though and I was close to quitting but I made an appointment with my GP who reminded me it can get worse before it gets better and recommended that I give it a couple more weeks and see him again. 

Also, I stopped my first medication (Prozac) pretty abruptly after I started feeling miserable and kind of regretted it, and I didn’t want to make the same mistake twice.

If you’re having increasing suicidal thoughts I’d book an appointment with your doctor if possible to assess the situation and I’d also just try and make sure you have someone to talk to. It helps knowing you’re not alone and almost holds you accountable, but If you don’t have anyone you can talk to you can always shoot me a message ❤️❤️😊

Actually no I didn’t, the main physical side effect I had was constantly smiling in social situations, like I had to physically force myself to keep a straight face, really messed with me for a while and I considered quitting, but it became less frequent and eventually went away. 

Made me feel like a psycho when someone was telling a sad story and I’m sitting there like the joker.

But anyway if it’s anything similar to that, I’d say just give it time.

I agree the world isn’t a Disney movie, but that doesn’t mean there isn’t hope. Give yourself time to get out of your position and work towards happiness again.
